Prioritization clarification (Phase 1, /dso:prioritize-epics):

This epic ports the Socratic "tell me more" / one-question-at-a-time dialogue pattern from /dso:brainstorm into the using-dso skill (the agent's general interaction surface). The goal is to reshape how the agent engages with the user across the board — from a blind executor that takes instructions and runs to a curious collaborator that pulls on threads, asks one clarifying question at a time, and surfaces ambiguity early. The benefit is better alignment with user intent before action, fewer wrong turns, and a calmer overall interaction model.

(Title updated in this pass: previously referenced 'lockpicks', corrected to the 'using-dso' skill name.)
